assertions.name: markov_parameter_is_the_block_mean_symbolically
assertions.source: sympy, exact over Q(q): sum_lambda y_lambda.chi_lambda(sigma) - q^3/(q^2+1) simplifies to 0, and sum_lambda f^lambda.y_lambda - 1 simplifies to 0, with the D weights (q^4+1)/(q^2+1)^2, q^2/(q^2+1)^2, 0 and characters q, h, -1/q. So z is the mean of the per-block loop values, not an independent parameter.

assertions.name: sign_block_weight_vanishes_under_D
assertions.source: p_(1^3) = f^(1^3).y_(1^3) = 0 under convention D, the n=3 case of the all-n WenzlWeightVanishing result (z_D is Wenzl level r=2, so every lambda with >=3 rows is annihilated). Under C the same weight is 0.02274494258, nonzero.

assertions.name: block_resolved_differs_from_mean_form
assertions.source: The Jensen gap is real and not a rounding artifact: blocks_full - mean_form = 0.002471312858 MeV. Evaluating at the mean is not the same as averaging the evaluation, so folding the cap in at the decomposition is a genuine change of functional form rather than a z-substitution — which is what decayLadder_zC_threeRow_ne_zero says is required.

description: Folds the convention-D Wenzl two-row cap into the Q_beta correction at the Wedderburn decomposition instead of through the phase alpha, which is the step bean qou-cds1 names as not yet done. Establishes symbolically that the Markov parameter z is the MEAN of the per-block loop values zeta_lambda = chi_lambda(sigma)/f^lambda under the probability weights p_lambda = f^lambda.y_lambda (sum = 1), exactly, with the D weights reproducing z_D = q^3/(q^2+1) and the sign block carrying weight zero. Form B therefore evaluates a nonlinear function AT the mean; the block-resolved object averages the function, a Jensen gap with no free parameter since the weights are Lean-proved rather than inverted from the measured Q-value. Reports both normalisations of the per-block form (the 1/z prefactor's per-block resolution is an assumption the corpus does not derive) and, as the formalize-first prune, the convex hull reachable under ANY weights. Scope-(a); nothing wired, nothing fitted, no c_k value proposed.
